label: Resterm: Run request
command:
env_file=
for dir in "$RESTERM_DIR" "$RESTERM_ROOT"; do
  for name in http-client.env.json rest-client.env.json resterm.env.json; do
    if [ -f "$dir/$name" ]; then
      env_file="$dir/$name"
      break 2
    fi
  done
done
set -- run --line "$RESTERM_LINE"
if [ -n "$env_file" ]; then
  set -- "$@" --env-file "$env_file"
fi
printf '%s' "$RESTERM_SOURCE" | resterm "$@" -

label: Resterm: Run all requests
command:
env_file=
for dir in "$RESTERM_DIR" "$RESTERM_ROOT"; do
  for name in http-client.env.json rest-client.env.json resterm.env.json; do
    if [ -f "$dir/$name" ]; then
      env_file="$dir/$name"
      break 2
    fi
  done
done
set -- run --all
if [ -n "$env_file" ]; then
  set -- "$@" --env-file "$env_file"
fi
resterm "$@" "$RESTERM_FILE"
